name: Jeshua
overview: Jeshua was a male Levite known for his role in explaining the law to the people, standing on the Levites' platform, and exhorting Israel to bless the Lord. He is identified as the son of Kadmiel and is noted as being 'of' Kadmiel, indicating his family lineage within the tribe of Levi. His leadership and teaching were significant during the time of the restoration of Israel's worship practices.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeshua means 'YHWH saves,' reflecting a theologically rich proper name. This meaning underscores the saving power of God, which may have been a source of encouragement to the people during his ministry.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jeshua as the son of Kadmiel and the father of Joiakim, establishing a clear familial line within the Levite tribe. These relationships highlight his place within a priestly family involved in the religious leadership of Israel.
scriptureSignificance: Jeshua's significance lies in his role as a spiritual leader who taught the law to the people, helping to restore proper worship and understanding of God's commands. By standing on the Levites' platform and exhorting Israel to bless the Lord, he actively participated in renewing the covenantal faith of Israel. His lineage as a Levite and his familial connections emphasize the continuity of priestly service during a critical period of Israel's history.
